abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis is characterised by psychiatric and neurological abnormalities and occurs in frequent association with ovarian teratoma. We report the first confirmed case of teratoma-associated anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis in Hong Kong in a young woman presenting with confusion and prominent dyskinesia, followed by a review of the current literature.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体脳炎は精神症状および神経症状を特徴とし、卵巣奇形腫を高頻度に伴う。香港で初めて確認された奇形腫関連の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例を、意識障害と著明なジスキネジアで発症した若年女性について報告し、現在の文献レビューを行った。
